disease_label_per_paper: Uveoparotid fever / incomplete Heerfordt syndrome as a presentation of sarcoidosis
presentation_summary: 54-year-old woman had episodes of epiphora, parotid enlargement and recurrent subjective fevers; ophthalmology had diagnosed anterior uveitis.
Chest radiograph showed prominent hilar lymphadenopathy and interstitial opacities consistent with pulmonary sarcoidosis.

Four years later she developed a 2-cm erythematous plaque on the left lateral arm, a 1.5-cm subcutaneous right mandibular nodule and a papule of the right nasal ala; punch biopsy revealed noncaseating granulomas.
